steps.description: Implement a numerical experiment to test the hypothesis on solution space rigidity using small feedforward networks. Design a function approximation task with analytical constraints (w constraints), sweep over hidden layer widths (N_c), and measure the maximum absolute error on a held-out constraint set. The goal is to determine if there exists a finite N_c that achieves zero violation (max error ≤ 1e-3) and whether N_c remains bounded as w increases. Files to modify: create a Python script that defines the constraint functions, builds the MLP, trains it, and computes the required metrics.
